name: docs
description: Documentation template for Kris Yotam projects

scripts.docs:dev: cd docs && TMPDIR=/tmp bunx --bun nuxt dev --extends ../layer
scripts.dev:prepare: bunx --bun nuxt prepare layer && bunx --bun nuxt prepare docs --extends ../layer && bunx --bun nuxt prepare playground --extends ../layer
scripts.verify: bun run dev:prepare && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run docs:build
scripts.release: bun run layer:release && bun run cli:release && release-it
scripts.clean: rm -rf .nuxt .output node_modules cli/node_modules docs/.nuxt docs/.data docs/node_modules layer/node_modules layer/.data analyze cli/dist docs/.nuxt docs/.output layer/.nuxt playground/.nuxt playground/.output playground/node_modules playground/.data bun.lock pnpm-lock.yaml .pnpm-store
